title: 30A East Coral Cay Inlet Beach, FL Stay at 30A Vacation Rentals

description_expanded: Overview5.0(3 reviews)Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beach Home!* Private Heated Pool and Hot Tub* Pet Friendly (add'l $250 fee, 1 pet under 15lbs)* Elevator – Easy access across all levels of the home* Close to the Beach – Easy access via the Lupine Beach Neighborhood Beach Walkover. Please Note: Beach access is via the Lupine Beach Neighborhood Beach Walkover. The beach walkover includes stairs and is not handicap accessible.* Gourmet Kitchen with High-End Finishes* Large Living Areas – Comfortable spaces designed for gathering, relaxing, and making memories* Near 30A Dining and Boutique Shopping – Convenient access to local restaurants, shops, and attractions* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **The neighborhood is growing, and construction may be taking place nearby, including in front of the home. Construction is outside of our control, and we want to be upfront so there are no surprises during your stay. We appreciate your understanding as this beautiful area continues to develop.**Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, pool/spa heater controls, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door and pool area.**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Coral Cay, a stunning coastal retreat where luxury, comfort, and unforgettable beach memories come together! Located in peaceful Inlet Beach, this beautifully designed home features 8 bedrooms, 8 full bathrooms, 2 half bathrooms, accommodates up to 21 guests. Coral Cay offers six King bedrooms, plus two additional bedrooms with flexible sleeping arrangements. One features a King bed and Queen bunk bed, while the other offers one Queen bed and three Twin beds. With every bedroom featuring its own private bathroom, guests can enjoy added privacy and convenience throughout the home. Step outside and enjoy the expansive outdoor living space featuring a private heated pool and hot tub. Coral Cay gives you plenty of ways to enjoy the beautiful coastal setting without putting you far from everything the 30A area has to offer!The Bed Setup:1st Floor:Guest Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: King Bed and Queen Bunk Bed 2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom: King Bed 3rd Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed and 3 Twin BedsArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
